test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Industrial Policy Statement of 1973, the private sector was allowed to apply for the license of their industry only after having a total assets of ₹ ______ or more.
solution:
The correct answer is __**20 crores.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **According to the Industrial Policy Statement of 1973:**

 
 
• **the private sector was allowed to apply for the license of their industry only after having total assets of Rs. 20 crores or more.​**
